dedupe_keys.name: mimu baseline data health facilities of myanmar by township and type gad 2019 township profiles p code 9 2

description: Myanmar Information Management Unit (MIMU) publishes an Excel workbook of the health facilities of Myanmar compiled by MIMU from the General Administration Department 2019 township profiles and MIMU place codes (P-code version 9.2): a Summary sheet with counts by township and facility type and a Detail sheet with one row per facility (name in English and Burmese, type, village, town or ward and its P-code, village tract, township and district codes); the Detail sheet holds 12,094 rows, of which 8,546 are sub-rural health centres, 1,638 rural health centres, 786 station hospitals, 247 township hospitals and 77 general hospitals, the rest smaller unit types. Coverage: all states and regions of Myanmar; the file is dated 26 November 2020 and reflects the 2019 township profiles. Format and access: an XLSX workbook downloadable without registration from the MIMU website. Licence (read on the portal page on 2026-09-29): Not stated on the pages read; cost: free. Caveats: the data are a 2019 baseline and the country has changed since; the workbook says no detailed list is available for the sub-rural health centres of Puta-O in Kachin, Mawlamyine, Mudon and Paung in Mon, and Kyunsu in Tanintharyi; there are no coordinates in the columns read (facilities are located by P-code), and no licence is stated on the pages read. Simulation uses: health-facility inventories for emergency-response, accessibility and service-continuity models after floods, cyclones and earthquakes, joined to P-code boundaries. Related catalogue records: Public Hospitals in Myanmar as of 2020 (MIMU) (data-myanmar-public-hospitals-mimu); Electric power substations in Myanmar, 2025 (MIMU and CDE Myanmar, non-authoritative point layer with voltage and operating status) (data-mimu-myanmar-electric-power-substations-2025); Myanmar transport layers from MIMU GeoNode: road network 2022, railway network 2022, bridges over 180 ft, airports and seaports (data-mimu-myanmar-road-rail-bridges-airports-seaports-layers); Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX) (data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange); OpenStreetMap (data-openstreetmap).
